newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser stands by EPS growth targets.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser stands by EPS growth targets.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc continues to target double-digit earnings per share growth for full-year 1997, said August Busch III, chairman and president, in remarks delivered at the company's annual shareholders meeting in Houston, Texas.

Earlier Wednesday, the company reported higher first-quarter results. Earnings were $258 million or $0.51 per share on net sales of $2.46 billion. A year ago, the company posted operating earnings of $242 million or $0.47 per diluted share on revenues of $2.37 billion. The 1996 results excluded a gain on the sale of the St. Louis Cardinals baseball team.
Including the gain, year-ago net income was $275 million or $0.53 per diluted share.
"These results are in line with our projections for the quarter, and we continue to target our objective of double-digit earnings per share growth for the full year 1997," Busch said.
